components.name: ButtonGroup
components.doc: Related actions joined into one surface: a shared border and radius, hairline dividers, no gaps. One soft highlight glides between segments under the pointer or keyboard focus, the pressed segment answers in place, and an optional chevron segment opens more actions in a menu aligned to the group's edge.

members.name: label
members.doc: Visible text and the accessible name. Changing it crossfades in place, so "Share" can answer "Copied".

members.name: reserve
members.doc: Every other label this segment can show, such as ["Copied"]. The segment sizes to the widest, so a label change never resizes it.

members.name: iconOnly
members.doc: Shows only the icon; the label becomes the accessible name and the tooltip.

members.name: content
members.doc: Visible content in place of the label, such as a live value. The label stays the accessible name.

members.name: href
members.doc: Renders the segment as a link.

members.name: destructive
members.doc: Colors the item as a destructive action.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name and tooltip of the chevron segment, such as "More actions".

members.name: menu
members.doc: Adds a trailing chevron segment that opens these actions in a menu aligned to the group's edge.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the group, such as "Document actions".

members.name: collapseLabels
members.doc: When the row does not fit its container, segments with an icon drop their label and keep the icon. Horizontal only.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every segment and the menu.
